messages:
neil: Quick RFC follow-up: proposal for a staged compat-shim + migration playbook for on-prem/airgapped upgrades. High-level idea below.

yasmin: Sounds good. Staged flows will cut down noisy rollback tickets.

neil: Playbook sketch:
- bundle: runtime image, compat-shim, signed manifest (schema v2)
- PREPARE: operator downloads, verifies signatures, stages into /var/lib/redwood/staged/<bundle> (no activation)
- ACTIVATE (canary -> fleet): switch activation_marker, start shim as proxy to runtime, begin background migrations
- CLEANUP: after safety-window and successful canary, gc old images
- ROLLBACK: keep last-known-good image + marker for 7 days for automatic fallback

raj: Important runtime constraints: do not require KV layout migration to complete before activation. Add `--migrate-kv=background` that runs low-priority migrator and exposes `runtime.kv.migrate_percent`. Also lazy-load model shard support so no cold full restart for big modelstores.

yasmin: Operator API changes: phases as explicit states PREPARE/ACTIVATE/CLEANUP + metric `operator.upgrades.phase{bundle}` and `operator.upgrades.progress_percent`. Add `activation_safety_window` TTL to delay GC. PREPARE should create deterministic `staged/` layout and record `operator.upgrades.staged_size_bytes`.

neil: Shim responsibilities idea: proxy older operator RPCs, translate manifest v1->v2 fields, expose composite health that includes shim+runtime for canaries.

operator-bot: deploy-bot: started canary roll for eng-cluster-3.

raj: Key rotation note: support two-phase key rewrap so old keys can decrypt until background rewrap completes. Flag `--allow-key-rewrap=true` and metric `runtime.key.rewrap_progress`.

tanya: From security: require signed transitional artifacts. We'll draft a signer-rotation runbook: operator announces rotation window, offline signer produces rotation attestations, include envelope in manifest for offline verification. Also add `verify-only` operator mode for dry-runs.

neil: Action items: yasmin -> operator API + metrics PR (INFRA-3421); raj -> runtime CLI + background-migration spec; tanya -> signing/attestation runbook; neil -> RFC follow-up with sample manifests. Target: draft by EOD next Thursday.

yasmin: PR draft: https://git.internal/repos/redwood/operator/pulls/87 :+1:

raj: will open runtime spec PR by EOW.

operator-bot: deploy-bot: canary succeeded on eng-cluster-3, health stable. :white_check_mark:

neil: Great. We'll fold canary telemetry into the RFC and include example manifest snippet and operator lifecycle docs. Thanks all.
